user.title: Create Invert / Not-True Helper
user.description: Create a helper binary sensor that tests whether a state or number is NOT equal to a target value, or inverts a boolean.

data_description.target_value: For 'State is NOT equal' or 'Number is NOT equal', enter a single value (e.g. 0, disarmed, home). For 'State is NOT in list', separate values by comma (e.g. home, work).

error.empty_target_value: Please enter a target comparison value for this mode.
